independentReviewer: C4 side-by-side Hornet v16 vs Hitch play_chase/abeam/close 2026-09-21
openGates: Hitch still wins panel language, lettering stencil, hull-wide dirt, hardware density
notes: PQ-050.01 chase_form_v16 cycle 4. C3 stills: Hitch won unique albedo, dirt, stencil, hardware density. This export: factory-gray hull, port ochre ID bars, unmirrored teal plate + repair, dorsal hatch/cable/hose/antenna, ceramic heat/soot at drive, RCS/nav. Principled blocks, no maps. Hitch/Kestrel frozen. Not a G7 or five-cycle close.

rows.notes: Eight chine stations: needle, canard, rounded canopy crown, wing-root beam, waist pinch, radiator house, drive house, tapered transom.
Skin-breaking FAST/EXACT booleans on canopy tub + raked windshield, dorsal radiator, wing wells, drive well + cylinder bore.
Chase-visible volumes: greenhouse well, dark fin cassette, drive throat, hatch, cable tray, hose. No seats.
Blunt-TE lofted wings, tip fences, TE bars, dogtooth crank, port ochre stencil bars that read at D=144.
Dark glass in a raked tub with brow/rails/sill. Antenna mast aft of the greenhouse.
Vanes recede in the bore; ceramic heat plates and soot apron around the throat. No gold mouth collar.
Dorsal cassette with dark fins; service hose on the dorsal skin from radiator house to drive.
No baked maps this pass. Principled islands instead of a 512 density trap.
